description: Skill Evidence backend layer: create SkillEvidence model, skillEvidenceController (with deterministic calculateConfidence), skillEvidenceRoutes, register in server.js, and add missing careerService.js helper functions. This is the foundational data layer that Tasks B, E, F, G, H, I, J, K all depend on.
steps: CREATE backend/models/SkillEvidence.js — evidenceSourceSchema: {type: enum[resume,project,internship,certificate,assessment,learning,interview,feedback], description: String, strength: enum[weak,moderate,strong], verifiedAt: Date, sourceId: String, notes: String}. skillEvidenceSchema: {user: ObjectId ref User required, skillName: String required, proficiency: enum[beginner,intermediate,advanced,expert] default beginner, confidenceScore: Number min 0 max 100 default 0, evidenceSources: [evidenceSourceSchema], relatedProjects: [String], relatedInternships: [ObjectId], lastVerified: Date, isVerified: Boolean default false}. Add compound index {user:1, skillName:1} unique. Export as 'SkillEvidence'.

CREATE backend/controllers/skillEvidenceController.js with these handlers, all wrapped in asyncHandler: (a) calculateConfidence(evidenceSources, isVerified) — pure function, no async, no AI. Weights: {resume:15, project:25, assessment:20, internship:15, learning:7, certificate:20, interview:10, feedback:8}. strengthMultiplier: {weak:0.5, moderate:1.0, strong:1.3}. Only count first occurrence of each evidence type (use a Set). isVerified adds 10% bonus to final sum before cap. Cap at 100. Return integer. (b) getSkillEvidence: GET — find all SkillEvidence for req.user.id, return array. (c) getSkillEvidenceBreakdown: GET — aggregate by skillName, return {skillName, confidenceScore, proficiency}[] keyed as object {[skillName]: confidenceScore}. (d) upsertSkillEvidence: POST — body {skillName, proficiency, evidenceType (maps to type), description, strength, notes}. Find existing doc or create new. Push new evidenceSource entry. Recalculate confidenceScore via calculateConfidence(). Save. If confidenceScore changed by >10 points from previous value, call createAndNotify(req.app, {recipient: req.user.id, title: 'Skill Confidence Updated', message: `Your ${skillName} confidence improved to ${newScore}%!`, type: 'success', priority: 'medium', link: '/dashboard/career'}). Return saved doc. (e) deleteSkillEvidence: DELETE /:id — find by _id and user, delete, return {success:true}. (f) getSkillConfidenceBreakdown: GET /breakdown — same as getSkillEvidenceBreakdown, kept for route clarity. Import: asyncHandler, SkillEvidence model, createAndNotify from notificationHelper.

CREATE backend/routes/skillEvidenceRoutes.js — import protect from authMiddleware, import all handlers from skillEvidenceController. Routes: GET / → getSkillEvidence; POST / → upsertSkillEvidence; GET /breakdown → getSkillEvidenceBreakdown; DELETE /:id → deleteSkillEvidence. All protected.
MODIFY backend/server.js — add line: app.use('/api/skill-evidence', require('./routes/skillEvidenceRoutes')); Place it after the /api/certificates line (around line 112). No other changes.

MODIFY frontend/src/services/careerService.js — verify existing exports getSkillEvidence, getSkillEvidenceBreakdown, addSkillEvidence already call /skill-evidence (they do — confirmed by reading). Add the following new exports that are missing: export const getSkillGapPriority = () => api.get('/career-intelligence/skill-gap-priority'); export const simulateWhatIf = (data) => api.post('/career-intelligence/what-if', data); export const getOpportunityUnlock = (skill) => api.get('/career-intelligence/opportunity-unlock', { params: { skill } }); export const getOpportunityCost = () => api.get('/career-intelligence/opportunity-cost'); export const getWhyNotApply = (internshipId) => api.get(`/career-intelligence/why-not-apply/${internshipId}`); export const getCounterfactual = (data) => api.post('/career-intelligence/counterfactual', data); export const getExplainableRec = (internshipId) => api.get(`/career-intelligence/explain/${internshipId}`); Also add them to the default export object.
acceptance_criteria: backend/models/SkillEvidence.js exists with compound unique index on {user, skillName}
calculateConfidence([{type:'project',strength:'strong'},{type:'project',strength:'strong'}], false) returns 33 (second project occurrence is skipped)
POST /api/skill-evidence with valid body returns 200 with a SkillEvidence document containing confidenceScore
GET /api/skill-evidence returns array for authenticated user
GET /api/skill-evidence/breakdown returns object keyed by skillName
node server.js starts without errors after changes
npm run build (frontend) succeeds after careerService.js additions
verification: cd backend && node -e "const s=require('./models/SkillEvidence'); console.log(s.schema.path('skillName').isRequired, s.schema.index())" — must not throw
cd backend && node server.js — must start without errors; check console for '[Routes]' lines
cd frontend && npm run build — must complete with exit code 0
findings: All files created and registered. calculateConfidence logic is deterministic and matches the described algorithm (weights × strengthMultiplier, first-occurrence-only via Set, isVerified adds 10% multiplicative bonus, capped at 100). Note: acceptance criteria test3 comment math is incorrect — (20*1.3+20*1.3+25*1.3)*1.1 = 92.95→93, not 100; the implementation correctly returns 93 for that input following the described algorithm. careerService.js now exports getSkillGapPriority, simulateWhatIf, getOpportunityUnlock, getOpportunityCost, getWhyNotApply, getCounterfactual, getExplainableRec as both named exports and in the default export object. Route /api/skill-evidence registered in server.js after /api/certificates. Temp verify_feat001.js script removed before commit.
